policy.name: Quotation approval
policy.description: Catalog items at list price with no discount are approved automatically; the Owner approves every other quotation.

preconditions.message: Every discounted line must state its discount type (volume, bundle, loyalty, multi-year SaaS or Owner exception).

policy.name: Solution Proposal approval
policy.description: The Owner approves every Solution Proposal; any edit after approval needs approval again. The approval is the signature stamp, and the QR on every page proves it.

policy.name: Invoice approval
policy.description: The Owner approves every invoice (and every credit note) before it is sent.

policy.name: Contract approval
policy.description: The Owner reviews every contract before it goes to the customer's authorized signatory.

policy.name: Purchase order approval
policy.description: Manufacturing Lead approves up to 5M (base currency); the Owner above that. 10M+ needs two vendor quotes.

preconditions.message: Purchases of 10,000,000 (base currency) or more need at least 2 vendor quotes (an RFQ with two responses, or two quote files attached).

policy.name: Bill of materials approval
policy.description: The Manufacturing Lead approves a bill of materials; the Owner too when one unit costs more than 25M (base currency). Production uses only an approved BOM.

policy.name: Contractor request approval
policy.description: The Owner authorizes every external contractor engagement before any commitment.

policy.name: Work order issuance
policy.description: A work order must link an Owner-approved contractor request; value above the approved estimate needs the Owner.

preconditions.message: A work order must link an Owner-approved contractor request.

policy.name: Vendor / contractor invoice approval
policy.description: < 5M Finance Admin; 5–25M Finance Admin + PM/Dept Head; 25–75M Owner; > 75M Owner with WO/PO evidence.

preconditions.message: Finance processes no invoice without a closed, approved work order or purchase order.

policy.name: Expense claim approval
policy.description: Line manager, then Finance Admin; the Owner too above 2M per claim or 1.5M per item (base currency).

preconditions.message: Expenses above 500,000 (base currency) need manager pre-approval before they are incurred; confirm pre-approval when submitting.

policy.name: External content approval
policy.description: Technical content gets an R&D Lead review and customer references a PM review before the Owner approves.

policy.name: Headcount approval
policy.description: The Owner approves every headcount request.

policy.name: Offer letter approval
policy.description: The Owner decides the offer; HR issues it; the candidate accepts within 5 business days.

policy.name: SOP publication approval
